critique: The orange monolith split into a cobalt-green stepped fissure is a bold, unfamiliar object-language, and its three detached fragments exploit the high-key chalk ground with excellent spare tension. The drifting red, green, and blue lens shapes rely on conventional smooth paths and opacity fades; sharper masking or deformation at the image boundary would make their claimed passage through the picture plane feel physically strange rather than merely crossfaded.
